# IoT Data Plane

Publish to the MQTT broker and manage shadows, retained messages, and connections.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `iotdataplane` |
| Signing name | `iotdata` |
| Wire protocol | REST JSON |
| API version | `2015-05-28` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | Local behavior |
| Selected operations | 10 of 11 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#iot-data-plane) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- Publish userProperties requires generator support and is not implemented.
- MQTT broker accepts at most QoS 1 and 128 KB payloads.
- Connections and subscriptions are in memory.
- The SDK needs an explicit local BaseEndpoint override.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.

## Supported operations

The table is generated from the profile and pinned Smithy model. Routes show REST bindings or the standard
JSON/Query endpoint. RPC v2 CBOR uses its service/operation route, as described in
[protocol handling](../architecture/request-flow.md). Supported members are selected separately in the
[shape whitelist](https://github.com/amjadjibon/tinystack/blob/main/generator/model/profile.json); an enabled operation may reject unsupported options.

| Operation | HTTP binding |
| --- | --- |
| `DeleteConnection` | `DELETE /connections/{clientId}` |
| `DeleteThingShadow` | `DELETE /things/{thingName}/shadow` |
| `GetConnection` | `GET /connections/{clientId}` |
| `GetRetainedMessage` | `GET /retainedMessage/{topic}` |
| `GetThingShadow` | `GET /things/{thingName}/shadow` |
| `ListNamedShadowsForThing` | `GET /api/things/shadow/ListNamedShadowsForThing/{thingName}` |
| `ListRetainedMessages` | `GET /retainedMessage` |
| `ListSubscriptions` | `GET /connections/{clientId}/subscriptions` |
| `Publish` | `POST /topics/{topic}` |
| `UpdateThingShadow` | `POST /things/{thingName}/shadow` |
